name: Zombie Rush: Testing
desc:
❌ This is NOT the official Zombie Rush game! ❌
This place is used for group members of Beacon Studio to test Zombie Rush updates before official release!

It's recommended that you play the release version of Zombie Rush as this place is completely experimental and could change at anytime. Stats such as kills, levels as well as items do not transfer to the release version.

✅ Official Zombie Rush game: https://rblx.co/ZombieRush
